description.value: A multimodal MRI study comparing structural GMV and resting-state functional characteristics, including ReHo, ALFF, and DC, among first-episode drug-naive schizophrenia patients, medicated chronic schizophrenia patients, and normal controls, with additional SVM-RFE classification of the three groups.

spans.text: In this study, we recruited 44 first-episode drug-naive SZ (FESZ) patients, 44 medicated chronic SZ (CSZ) patients, and 56 normal controls (NCs) and acquired their structural and resting-state functional magnetic resonance imaging (MRI).

value: Structural and functional brain abnormalities are widespread in both the FESZ and CSZ groups.
These abnormalities are critical for the discrimination of three groups.

spans.text: We hypothesize that 1) structural and functional brain abnormalities are widespread in both the FESZ and CSZ groups and 2) these abnormalities are critical for the discrimination of three groups.

description.value: Cross-sectional observational study of three participant groups: first-episode drug-naive schizophrenia patients, medicated chronic schizophrenia patients, and normal controls. Participants were recruited from Guangzhou Brain Hospital and the local community; no intervention allocation or blinding was reported.

description.value: Structured clinical interview used by trained and experienced clinical psychiatrists to diagnose schizophrenia and assess psychiatric disorders.

spans.text: The SZ patients were diagnosed by trained and experienced clinical psychiatrists according to the structured clinical interview according to   Diagnostic and Statistical Manual of Mental Disorders-IV-Text Revision   (DSM-IV-TR) (SCID) criteria.

description.value: Clinical assessment performed by psychiatrists before scanning to measure positive symptoms, negative symptoms, and general psychopathology severity.

spans.text: Before scanning, a clinical assessment was performed by psychiatrists using the Positive and Negative Syndrome Scale (PANSS).

value: First-episode drug-naive schizophrenia; PANSS total score of at least 60; at least three positive symptom items on PANSS with a score of at least 4; first seeking help because of psychotic symptoms; no antipsychotic drug use.

spans.text: The inclusion criteria for all SZ patients were 1) a total score of at least 60 for the three PANSS subscales and 2) at least three positive symptom items on the PANSS with a score of at least 4.

description.value: Structural and resting-state functional MRI preprocessing using SPM8 and DPABI.

spans.text: Individual rs-fMRIs were preprocessed using SPM8 (  http://www.fil.ion.ucl.ac.uk/spm  ; Institute of Neurology, University College London) and Data Processing & Analysis for Brain Imaging (DPABI).
Individual rs-fMRIs were preprocessed using SPM8 (  http://www.fil.ion.ucl.ac.uk/spm  ; Institute of Neurology, University College London) and Data Processing & Analysis for Brain Imaging (DPABI).

For each subject, the rs-fMRI data were collected using an echo-planar imaging (EPI) sequence (64×64×33 matrix with 3.44×3.44×4.6 mm  spatial resolution, echo time=30 ms, time to repeat=9,000 ms, acquisition time=2,000 ms, flip angle=90°, field of view=211×211 mm ).

description.value: Participants kept their eyes closed, relaxed without falling asleep, and moved as little as possible during resting-state fMRI acquisition.

spans.text: The participants were instructed to keep their eyes closed, to relax but not fall asleep, and to move as little as possible.
